## Dependency

The workflow runs the `geo` CLI from the `geo-optimizer-skill` Python package (see upstream README). Install it in a virtual environment.

## Role in the Master SEO Skill Set

**AI-readiness score only** (0–100, before/after tracking, AI crawler tiers). For the qualitative GEO audit use claude-seo `seo-geo`. For Google AI features use `skills/ai-search-answer-workflow`. The score is this tool's own rubric, not a Google metric; report it as such.
